comment: The knob-plus-CV total is clamped to a gain of 0 to 2, which is 0 to 200%, so no sumRange voltage is given. With the limiter off SickoAmp.cpp:106 sets the clamp to 10 rather than removing it, so ±10V is always the ceiling. In the mono-output branch the channels are summed before the gain is applied, and when the LEVEL input is polyphonic the gain used there is the one worked out for the last channel (SickoAmp.cpp:204-213).
